contract.review_scope: Body-level static contract; transitive application and called-module completeness are separate.
contract.purpose: Refresh stored wave totals from current shipment-header view aggregates.
inputs_defaults: waveNum numeric(9), processStamp nvarchar(100), userStamp nvarchar(30); required, no defaults.
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: NULL/missing wave statistics row is not inserted. Empty shipment input yields zero totals for an existing target. Mixed source units are not converted or validated by MAX.
output_shape: No intentional result set. No affected-row count is promised as an application result.

ordered_branches.explanation: Aggregate wave shipment count, line count, quantity, value, weight and volume through SHIPMENT_HEADER_VIEW with NOLOCK.
Update matching statistics row; missing sums become zero. Preserve existing unit fields, or use MAX source unit when target unit is NULL; stamp and check error.

contract.status_and_quantity_effects: Replaces summary totals and fills missing unit labels; does not allocate inventory or change shipment lines.
configuration_scope_and_precedence: No configuration lookup in this body; identifiers and status values are supplied by the caller.
error_and_return_handling: Final @@ERROR nonzero returns -1; no rowcount/missing-target result or transaction.
contract.transaction_ownership: No explicit transaction, commit, rollback, savepoint, TRY/CATCH or XACT_ABORT is introduced by this body; caller/session semantics remain authoritative.
concurrency: NOLOCK source reads can observe uncommitted/inconsistent totals; these are a stored refresh, not a guaranteed point-in-time operational census.
contract.trigger_behavior: No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE trigger on these target tables is present in the captured six-trigger inventory, except SHIPPING_CONTAINER has an INSERT-only trigger and WORK_INSTRUCTION has an INSERT-only trigger; updates/deletes here do not directly activate those INSERT events. Constraints and caller actions still apply.
external_handoffs_and_gaps: Transitive SHIPMENT_HEADER_VIEW definition and current source data remain separate; no complete allocation, execution or accounting meaning is established.

NO_CAPTURED_REFERENCE means none of the credited channels in this exact retained corpus identified the table. It does not establish that the table is unused, obsolete, a backup, safe to delete, or absent from external application SQL.
Dynamic SQL, runtime-selected identifiers, external callers, client-generated SQL, uncaptured jobs and historical/other database code can use tables without a resolvable reference here.
